can_label.fine: Contents under pressure. Keep away from heat, sparks and open flame. Do not pierce or burn, even when empty. Use in a ventilated place. Shake for one minute before use. Dura-Krome Industrial. Discontinued.

tags.description: An old Dura-Krome can for touching up bumpers, from before anybody stopped making it. Aluminium flake: the paint dries mirror-bright, light at the top and dark under. Sprays chrome.
